_description: Units available for training, per faction (random armies, tools/nn/armies, docs/en/training/armies.md). A new unit or faction is a new entry here; its passport must be in config/nn/units.json (cost multiplayer_cost, category, men), then py -3.14 -m tools.nn.armies.templates. slot: the unit's name in an army (slot_1, slot_2, ...); width: frontage in m at deployment (default men / rank_depth files x 1.5 m); generator: the faction's config of the game's army generator (cdir_military_generator_configs), whose templates set the proportions of template armies; units_v2: units only the v2 army scheme fields (run.py --armies v2, training) besides `units` - the old scheme (the evaluation seeds, the gate, the twin) keeps its armies bit for bit (11.10.2026: the Halberdiers, the Ratling Gun, the Plague Monks and Censer Bearers, the Giant Rats); budget_factor (default 1.0): the faction's gold relative to the other side's after the equal-budget draw (a side's budget is B x its factor / the larger factor of the two, so mirrors stay equal). Every faction is at 1.0 since 02.10.2026: the Skaven's 0.8 of 01.10.2026 (they won all 10 equal-budget whole battles in the game, docs/en/training/measurements.md) made them lose ~90% in the simulator; the Empire got shielded units instead (docs/en/training/armies.md).

mix._description: Share of armies (per side) built by the faction's army templates (as the campaign AI) and pure random within the pool and budget (as a human might, stacks included).

_template_rule: How a template's ratios reach the pool's units (tools/nn/armies/pools.py, docs/en/training/armies.md): 'group' (07.10.2026) - a ratio on a generator group goes to the pool's units under that group (the templates ask groups that hold no unit themselves, e.g. melee_infantry 54 times: a group stands for its subtree), and to the parent group's units when none of those can be bought; an even split within the group reached (the quality tier's rule is not known). 'family' (before) - the ratios summed by the root of the group chain, split evenly over the pool's units of that family.
_budget_rare: Rich battles of elite units (tools/nn/armies/generate.py): this share of battles draws B log-uniform between the usual top (budget_max, the factions' budget_max) and max (at most what both sides can reach with 19 units and the lord); share 0 or max null: none, and no random draw is made (every battle as before). Raise step by step (docs/en/training/armies.md).
_budget_max: The largest budget B drawn (tools/nn/armies/pools.py budget_max): 7725 = the Empire's most before 02.10.2026 (the general and 19 swordsmen). The greatswords (850) would raise an Empire mirror's top to 16750 and shift every Empire mirror to richer armies; the cap keeps the budgets as they were.
_mages: Casters in the armies (tools/nn/armies/generate.py add_mages, pools.py mages; docs/en/training/armies.md): this share of battles gives each side its faction's caster - the Gold Wizard (Lore of Metal, Searing Doom) and the Warlock Engineer (Lore of Ruin, Warp Lightning), their level-1 spells (build/magic/plan.md 1) - beside the lord, on top of its army (250 / 400 gold), with exactly the passport's spells in the battle file. A side a script plays loses its caster at the start (tools/nn/sim/magic.py leave_scripted: no script casts). Passports in data/units/probe-units.json (the simulator takes them while the share is above 0, tools/nn/sim/params.py). share 0 (the default, 16.10.2026: the network does not see magic yet): no random draw, every battle as before.

armies_v2._description: The second army scheme (user 11.10.2026; tools/nn/armies/generate.py generate_v2, docs/en/training/armies.md), for training (run.py --armies v2) and AI-vs-AI battles; the old scheme (budget B, then armies under B) stays for the evaluation seeds, the gate and the twin. counts: [first, last, share] - a side's number of units besides the lord is drawn per side: a band by its share, then evenly inside it (the game: 20 units with the lord). ceiling: [low, high] - the budget ceiling, evenly. The side of fewer units is built first, its price evenly between its cheapest and min(ceiling, its dearest) army of that many units; the other side buys for the same gold (+-5%), with fewer units when even its cheapest units do not fit. The pools' and factions' budget_max do not apply.

caps._description: Template armies only: share of an army's units (the lord counted) that may be of one passport category, rounded down, at least 1. Random armies have no caps.

wh2_main_skv_skaven._budget_max: The most a Skaven side spends: 6700 = the Skaven's most before 02.10.2026 (the Warlord and 19 clanrat spearmen). The Night Runners (450) and the clanrats with shields (350) would raise it to 9075 and shift every battle with Skaven to richer armies (B is capped by what both sides can field); the cap keeps the budgets as they were.
